description: MutatorAgent eval (eng review D11): each command runs N times against live Muse Spark through the real verifier and repair loop, on the demo street (frontend/src/scene/syntheticScene.ts). expect: install = a plugin passes within 2 repairs; decline = nothing gets installed (the API can't do it). `pointer` simulates the user pointing at an entity while saying "this". Bar: 4 of 5 runs per command.

cases.text: make the gravity feel like on the moon
make the truck ten times heavier
make gravity pull everything to the right
when the ball hits the ground, make it jump back up twice as high
make the bottle sound like a marimba
